ai_first.d: An agent that summarizes a record saves minutes. One that updates a policy, opens a dispute in the core system or issues a quote changes a process. That takes integration, permissions and testing.
Agents reason over what they can see. We design Data 360 models, zero copy connections and identity resolution so the agent sees the customer your best employee would see.
Pilots tend to stall on access to core systems, not on prompts. MuleSoft, Agent Fabric and your existing middleware decide how far an agent can go.
We test agents like products: scripted conversations, adversarial prompts, regression on each Salesforce release, and a pass mark the business agrees before launch.
Human approval steps, audit logs, data residency and least-privilege access are designed in the first sprint, because banks, insurers and health plans cannot retrofit them.
Every agent ships with a KPI baseline and a run book. After go-live we track resolution, cost per action and drift, and report them to you on a fixed cadence.
